# Copilot Sessions History

- In this workspace, “Sessions” means VS Code Copilot conversation history. Do not confuse it with the app's community messages, email-game messages, or chess move history.
- When prior-session context is relevant and Chronicle/session-history tools are available, scope searches to this repository and inspect the actual turns and changed-file records before drawing conclusions.
- Treat session history as supporting context, not as the current source of truth. Verify relevant code and configuration in the workspace before proposing or making changes.
- If no relevant sessions are indexed or history tools are unavailable, state that limitation and continue from the current workspace without inferring prior decisions.
